title: Social icons in use
slide_intent: Show how much work the avatar and the post each need to do in a social setting.
strategic_value: A recognizable profile image can identify the account while a separate story carries a food-led message.
demonstration: The left side enlarges a social profile with the carrot avatar. The right side shows a story with food preparation over the headline Get Saucey.
practical_value: Use the pair to distinguish an account identifier from the content published by that account.

content_islands.name: Profile crop
content_islands.spec: Place the enlarged phone profile against a light field. Keep the primary avatar and account name visible.

content_islands.name: Story specimen
content_islands.spec: Center the portrait story on a dark green field. Pair a food photograph with its headline in a separate light panel.
